description.en: Returns CNBC quote-cache records. A browser-like User-Agent and CNBC Referer were required in a reproducible 2026-08-10 request; the same request without them received HTTP 403 from Akamai. Multiple symbols must be separated with `|`; a comma-separated `AAPL,MSFT` request was treated as one invalid symbol and returned `code: 1`. Numeric market values are generally locale-formatted strings (for example `313.33`, `32,322,778`, `4.573T`, and `+0.29%`), so consumers must not assume JSON numbers. Delayed/real-time status and attribution are conveyed by fields such as `source`, `provider`, and `realTime`.
